Sent entries wait for the exponential /// delay and stop being selected once [maxAttempts] is reached, if configured. /// `push(force: true)` bypasses both filters. The legacy [PendingDeltaStore] /// path has no attempt metadata; every push retries its retained delta. class SyncRetryPolicy
members: const SyncRetryPolicy({ this.baseDelay = const Duration(seconds: 1), this.maxDelay = const Duration(minutes: 1), this.maxAttempts, })

SqfliteReplicaStorage.declaration: /// SQLite implementation of [ReplicaStorage]. /// /// Pass `sqflite`'s `databaseFactory` from Flutter, or another compatible /// factory such as `sqflite_common_ffi` on desktop. This package depends only /// on the sqflite API and keeps Flutter out of core, sync, and storage. class SqfliteReplicaStorage implements ReplicaStorage
